description: An app analytics dashboard with a metric switcher, an interactive area chart, and a regional breakdown.
overview: An analytics dashboard for apps: pick a metric, read its current value and growth, and hover the 12-week area chart to see any week's figure in the headline. A By region list below breaks the metric down by share. It sits in an `AppShell`, so the app list is a sidebar on desktop and a tab bar on mobile. Start here for product analytics, traffic or revenue reports.
usage: Replace `metrics` with your series; each metric has a label, unit, current value and 12 weekly data points. `regions` holds each region's share, and `apps` and `items` fill the navigation. The sample fakes per-app numbers by scaling the first app's data and computes growth on the fly, so load real figures per app from your analytics source.
notes: The headline value is announced as you move through the chart, and the chart supports keyboard navigation.
